code:
df = spark.read.parquet("cleansed/yellow_tripdata_2024-01.parquet")

df_filtered = df.filter(df["fare_amount"] > 0)
# df is completely unchanged. df_filtered is a NEW DataFrame.

print(df.count())            # original count
print(df_filtered.count())   # different, smaller count
caption: Unlike Pandas' in-place-feeling df[...] = ..., Spark makes this explicit and unavoidable.
